data.body: Close-verifier follow-up: after external criteria were correctly operator-attested, one remaining FAIL falsely stated that tests/unit/test_agent_call_seam.py consisted only of a COMMIT steering notice. The merged file actually contains the tested Python module; focused tests and CI passed it. This proves a distinct synthetic-result attribution fragility: a losing same-response read_file call can return COMMIT_STEERING_NOTICE and the model may mistake that result for file contents. Filed 99d3-8618-654b-4f03 and linked discovered_from. This does not reproduce the original 0707 defect: the run banked progress and returned a normal evidence-backed FAIL rather than exhausting with zero banks. Exact repository evidence for retry: tests/unit/test_agent_call_seam.py:77-148 contains test_completion_metadata_adds_policy_between_memo_and_runaway and test_unflagged_and_lookalike_metadata_preserve_the_old_wrapper_identity; commit c3aec3eae6 is merged and CI run 31313461379 passed all 15 jobs.
